an3.104:1.1: lokassāhaṃ bhikkhave assādapariyesanaṃ ācariṃ yo loke assādo tadajjhagamaṃ
an3.104:1.2: yāvatako loke assādo paññāya me so sudiṭṭho.
an3.104:1.3: lokassāhaṃ bhikkhave ādīnavapariyesanaṃ ācariṃ yo loke ādīnavo tadajjhagamaṃ
an3.104:1.4: yāvatako loke ādīnavo paññāya me so sudiṭṭho.
an3.104:1.5: lokassāhaṃ bhikkhave nissaraṇapariyesanaṃ ācariṃ yaṃ loke nissaraṇaṃ tadajjhagamaṃ
an3.104:1.6: yāvatakaṃ loke nissaraṇaṃ paññāya me taṃ sudiṭṭhaṃ.
an3.104:1.7: yāvakīvañcāhaṃ bhikkhave lokassa assādañca assādato ādīnavañca ādīnavato nissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ nābbhaññāsiṃ neva tāvāhaṃ bhikkhave sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho paccaññāsiṃ.
an3.104:1.8: yato ca khohaṃ bhikkhave lokassa assādañca assādato ādīnavañca ādīnavato nissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ athāhaṃ bhikkhave sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho paccaññāsiṃ.
an3.104:1.10: akuppā me vimutti ayamantimā jāti natthidāni punabbhavoti. 106
